description: This file provides tools for inspecting TorchScript models, extracting model information, serializing it as JSON, and generating HTML skeletons for visualization. It includes functions for parsing pickled data, handling zip archives, and inlining model info into HTML templates.

methods.name: get_storage_info
methods.description: Extracts storage information from a FakeObject storage, verifying its structure and returning a list of storage details.

methods.name: hierarchical_pickle
methods.description: Recursively serializes complex data structures, including torch pickled objects, into JSON-compatible formats.

methods.name: get_model_info
methods.description: Reads a zip archive of a TorchScript model, extracts metadata, code files, pickled data, and serializes it into a JSON-friendly dictionary.

methods.name: get_inline_skeleton
methods.description: Loads and returns an HTML skeleton with embedded JavaScript modules for in-browser visualization, inlining external JS resources.

methods.name: burn_in_info
methods.description: Embeds model information into an HTML skeleton by replacing a placeholder with JSON data, producing a self-contained page.

methods.name: get_info_and_burn_skeleton
methods.description: Combines model info extraction and HTML skeleton inlining to produce a complete HTML page with embedded model data.
